units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:2">Ab. I, 2</cite> <he>שמעון הצ׳</he> Simon the Just.

<cite ref="Berakhot 7a:25">Ber. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>צ׳ וטוב לו צ׳ בן צ׳</he> a righteous man faring well is a righteous man and the son of a righteous man, opp. <cite ref="T01099"><he>רשע</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49:9">Gen. R. s. 49</cite> <he>לא את הוא צַדִּיקוֹ של עולם</he> art not thou, (Lord) the righteous one of the world? <cite ref="Yoma 37a:3">Yoma 37ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 10:7">Prov. X, 7</cite>) <he>בשעה … צ׳ עולמים וכ׳</he> when I mention the righteous (ruler) of worlds, give ye blessing.—Pl. <he>צַדִּיקִים</he>.
Ber. 18ᵃ (ref. to Koh. IX, 5) אלו צ׳ שבמיתתן וכ׳ this refers to the righteous who are called living even when they are dead. Gen. R. l. c., v. נִבְלָא II; a. fr.—Fem. צַדֶּקֶת.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 48:8">Gen. R. s. 48</cite> <he>אותה הצ׳</he> that pious woman (Sarah).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63:8">Gen. R. s. 63</cite> <he>הצ׳ הזו</he> that pious woman (Rebecca); a. fr.—Pl. <he>צַדִּיקוֹת</he>.
